comment: What tools/image/smoke.mjs needs that is particular to this repo: the bin (its log topic), a command that makes one request (no key: the mock asks for none, and the client then sends no Authorization header), the exit code of a network error, the mock answer to that request (by path, under --base-url http://mock:8080; recorded live 2026-11-20), and a string the printed answer contains.
